crossRefs.note: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you…
whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest…
For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation…
For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
Ah sinful nation, a people loaded with iniquity, offspring of evildoers, children who deal corruptly! They have…
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked…
and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word…
But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as…
For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy…
For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who…
These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of…
They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

translations.web: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,
translations.bsb: They are the kind who worm their way into households and captivate vulnerable women who are weighed down with sins and led astray by various passions,
translations.kjv: For of this sort are they which creep into houses, and lead captive silly women laden with sins, led away with divers lusts,
translations.asv: For of these are they that creep into houses, and take captive silly women laden with sins, led away by divers lusts,
